spec.name: Furniture Skeleton Greeter
spec.description: An ivory skeleton Halloween decoration with an open three-tier rib cage, painted black eye sockets, a raised waving hand and an off-center purple top hat. Connected, axis-aligned construction stands on a discreet dark oak base. Front faces negative Z; all geometry fits within the requested bounds.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: standing stylized ivory skeleton Halloween prop with a clear rib cage, black eye sockets and one raised waving hand, wearing a tiny crooked purple top hat; feet on a discreet dark stable base. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..16, y=0..32, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Standing on floor y=0. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
